request.style: English, male tenor solo with choir, harp, cello, flute, timpani, solemn and epic, 75 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
In days of Amraphel king of Shinar
Arioch ruled in Ellasar
Chedorlaomer of Elam stood
Tidal king of Goiim led

[Verse]
Four kings formed a powerful band
Against the five in the land
Sodom and Gomorrah marched out
Admah and Zeboiim fought

[Chorus]
Valley of Siddim full of pits
Tar rose up as the dust
Kings of Sodom fell inside
Gomorrah kings could not hide

[Verse]
The victors seized goods and food
Provisions taken from the wood
Lot was taken from his home
Abram heard the sorrowing tone

[Pre-Chorus]
Three hundred eighteen men
Born in his household when
He pursued to Dan and far
North of Damascus at war

[Chorus]
Valley of Siddim full of pits
Tar rose up as the dust
Kings of Sodom fell inside
Gomorrah kings could not hide

[Bridge]
He divided his forces at night
Attacked in the fading light
Recovered all the goods
Brought Lot back from the crowds

[Outro]
Women and people restored
Abram’s story is recorded
